definition: a sweet food made from roasted and ground cacao seeds
hook: Chocolate was not sweet, and it was not even a food.
modernAnchor: A wrapped bar, a hot mug, a box tied with ribbon. We call it chocolate.
journey: The Aztecs ground cacao seeds and poured the paste between vessels until the surface carried a thick foam.
They drank it unsweetened and spiced with chilli, and the name said exactly how it tasted: xocolatl, bitter water.
Spanish colonists carried the drink home and buried the bitterness under sugar, cinnamon and milk.
Three centuries later it was pressed into a solid bar and handed to children. The taste is gone, and only the name still remembers it.
